name: NPM Outdated
author: Widgeter
description: Outdated npm dependencies of a project folder, grouped by major, minor and patch updates, from npm outdated.

config.label: Project folder
config.help: Folder containing package.json. Run npm install there first so installed versions can be compared.

config.label: Re-check every (minutes)
config.help: npm contacts the registry for every check, so keep this reasonably long. The refresh button checks immediately.
